services.name: Tarpon Fishing
services.desc: We fish the shallow back-country waters in and around Sarasota Bay, and the inshore reefs of the Gulf of Mexico The fishing charter service you choose could mean the difference between catching the big one, or telling a story about the one that got away. At C.B.’s Saltwater Outfitters, our veteran guides will do their best to make sure your stay in our Sarasota, Siesta Key area is memorable. Let us arrange an exciting trip to the shallow water backcountry to sight fish for snook, redfish, speckled trout and other species, or fishing trips to the inshore reefs of the Gulf of Mexico for giant tarpon, bonito, cobia, tripletail, jack crevalle, kingfish, Spanish mackerel. services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: We have the perfect Siesta Key Boat Rental for any group. We rent runabouts, center consoles, deck boats, and pontoon boats and offer half day and all day boat rentals from 8 am to 5 pm daily. Our boat rentals run from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. through miles of Sarasota’s most beautiful intercoastal waterways. The route reveals Sarasota’s natural beauty with tropical trees, flowers, and exotic birds all alongside mangroves, sandbars, and beaches. Our docks are located behind our Sarasota Store on Siesta Key. Rental customers NEED at least two years of experience, and be at least 26 years of age.
